subject: Exclusive Summer Sale: Up to 50% off on Select Items!
body: Dear valued customer, We are thrilled to announce our Exclusive Summer Sale starting next week! Get ready to enjoy discounts of up to 50% on select items, including summer essentials and popular products. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to refresh your wardrobe and elevate your style for the season. Stay tuned for more details on the sale and be the first to shop the best deals. Start making your wishlist now! Best regards, The Fashion Store Team
